task_instance: Attempt to run the expo-skill-eval pipeline for one Expo skill (e.g. produce trigger-eval results, an executor-generated app diff, a runtime screenshot, and a viewer.html) as the skill's core deliverable would require.
blocker_detail: The skill's entire core deliverable is impossible without code/command execution, which this office-assistant runtime does not grant. Every phase of the pipeline requires running shell commands and executables: `claude -p` subprocesses (trigger eval and executor generation), `bunx create-expo-app` fixtures, `tsc --noEmit` / `expo lint` / `expo export` (static gate), `expo start` / `expo run` with iOS Simulator (Xcode/simctl) and Android emulator (AVD/adb) plus Playwright/Chromium for web, screenshot capture, and Python orchestrator scripts (`run_trigger_eval_real.py`, `run_executors.py`, `run_static.py`, `run_snapshots.py`, `generate_viewer.py`) all invoked via `python3`/`bash`. It also requires macOS with Xcode and an Android SDK/AVD, and produces PNG screenshots and a self-contained HTML viewer with embedded binary image data as its final output. This runtime can only read/write/edit text files and fetch/search the public web -- it explicitly cannot run any code, scripts, or shell commands, cannot install software, and cannot produce binary files. There is no reduced-but-real version of the deliverable reachable this way: even the 'no device' Code checks mode still needs `tsc`/`expo lint`/`expo export` to actually execute, and the trigger-accuracy mode needs `claude -p` subprocesses to actually run. Per the additional rules, I did not write a stub/mock/shim of these tools or fabricate the outputs (e.g. a fake screenshot or fake trigger-eval pass/fail) they would produce.
evidence: Read the skill document at /home/user/skill-achievability-compiler/benchmark/ce_sources/expo__skills__expo-skill-eval/SKILL.md in full. Its 'Pipeline per eval case' section (steps 0-6) and 'Orchestration model' paragraph state the pipeline is driven almost entirely by `python3 <orchestrator>` scripts that in turn call `bash scripts/*.sh` (make-workspace.sh, make-fixture.sh, check-static.sh, snapshot-ios.sh, snapshot-android.sh, snapshot-web.sh, clean-fixture.sh, generate_viewer.py) and `claude -p` subprocess calls -- none of which can be executed in a code-execution-free, text-only runtime. Requirements line explicitly states 'macOS with Xcode (iOS simulators), Android SDK with at least one AVD, and bun.' No no-op or text-only path exists that would still exercise the skill's stated purpose (trigger accuracy / code quality / runtime screenshots of an Expo app). No result files, code, or fabricated outputs were produced other than this result.json, per the rule against stubbing missing tools/scripts.
